primary_question: Does evidence-grounded interaction improve external decisions beyond equal-compute noninteractive and ordinary-review controls?

process_evaluation_layers.name: deterministic_contract
process_evaluation_layers.claim_scope: source, candidate, target, state-transition and decision-impact checks only

process_evaluation_layers.name: programmatic_controlled_corruptions
process_evaluation_layers.claim_scope: known catalog fact mutations with generated labels

process_evaluation_layers.name: blinded_model_proxy_panel
process_evaluation_layers.claim_scope: two independent judges and a third judge on disagreement

published_result_policy.otherwise: Use as literature context only; implement a structural baseline or faithful reproduction and report original and reproduced values separately.
published_result_policy.never: Treat a published number from a different setup as a head-to-head experimental result.

stage_gates.p0_p1: literature inheritance table, data/label audit, and candidate headroom accepted
stage_gates.p2: adapters, complete ledger, frozen and sequential semantics, replay, and isolation tests accepted
stage_gates.p3: E1 and E2 engineering/development results include deterministic, controlled-corruption and blinded proxy attribution
stage_gates.p4: only after E2 has credible external and process-level incremental evidence
stage_gates.p5: preregistered independent test with power, clustering, multiplicity, and cost rules frozen
